truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.7.2; fixed in 2.7.2 (bytecode cache files written to the shared system temp directory).

The advisory for this ID links no commit. The fix is acb672b 'Fixed a security issue with temporary files on the filesystem cache on UNIX', in tag 2.7.2 and not in 2.7.1. It is linked from the sibling advisory GHSA-fqh9-2qgg-h84h instead. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/acb672b6a179567632e032f547582f30fa2f4aa7
Added, not vulnerable: FileSystemBytecodeCache._get_default_cache_dir. The class docstring change is cosmetic.
Entry point: the class, re-exported as jinja2.FileSystemBytecodeCache (jinja2/__init__.py line 41 at 2.7.2).
